title: WF03 OIDC-27..34 validation blockers: Zig 0.16 test API drift, OIDC-34 query-result mutability mismatch, OIDC-31 stale pool API, and Windows integration env task fragility
summary: Resolved all reported WF03 blockers for OIDC-27..34 validation by updating two unit tests to Zig 0.16 filesystem APIs, fixing OIDC-34 migration helper QueryResult mutability, updating OIDC-31 preflight test from stale pg.Pool usage to the workspace pool module API, and replacing fragile inline PowerShell task quoting with a script-based integration runner that reliably injects BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

root_cause.details: Multiple artifacts were authored against older assumptions: std.fs.cwd API in unit tests, pg.Pool symbol usage in focused integration preflight, const QueryResult deinit in migration helper, and a VS Code task command string that broke PowerShell URL assignment under nested quoting.

changes: Updated tests/unit/test_oidc28_local_dev_realm.zig and tests/unit/test_oidc32_agent_test_identities.zig to use std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc with std.Io.Limit.
Changed src/oidc/migration_helper.zig listUnlinkedInternalUsers rows binding from const to var so deinit receives mutable QueryResult.
Reworked tests/integration/oidc31_end_to_end_auth_suite_test.zig to use @import("pool") and pool_mod.Pool.init/queryRow semantics.
Updated build.zig OIDC-31 focused test target imports to provide the pool module.
Reworked .vscode/tasks.json zig-test-integration to execute .vscode/run-zig-test-integration.ps1, ensuring deterministic BPM_TEST_DB_URL injection on Windows PowerShell.

commands.evidence: Command completed with no compile output.
Command completed with no compile/test failure output.

prevention: For Zig 0.16-targeted tests, mirror the repository's std.Io.Dir.cwd patterns instead of std.fs.cwd.
Use the local pool module abstraction in integration tests; do not depend directly on vendor pg symbols unless verified in the current vendor API.
Avoid inline PowerShell environment setup with URL literals inside task command strings; prefer script-file execution for deterministic quoting behavior.
